blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: UK Biobank is a British clinical study which, in addition to large amounts of medical data collected, plans to include detailed Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) examina- tions from 100,000 participants. The image data can be analyzed for example by auto- mated analysis with neural networks for image segmentation or classification to expand the collection of image-derived phenotypes for medical research. In this work, we pro- pose, present and evaluate a methodology that uses image-based regression to estimate numerical properties from the collected neck-to-knee water-fat MRI scans. It applies a ResNet50-style network to 2D multi-channel collages that represent targeted and study- specific anatomical sub-regions from the MRI scan. The targeted sub-region sampling is achieved by propagating manually defined subregions from a reference scan to the other >30,000 analyzed scans using image registration. The resulting collages can be compact while retaining high-resolution, for example by providing multiple slices of kidney tissue for a kidney volume regression network. This approach also enables group-wise saliency analysis that highlight image and anatomical regions used by the network for the pre- dictions. The method was applied for the regression endpoints of kidney volume, heart volume, and age. Predictive performance was found between R2 = 0.731-0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions. We con- clude that the method can be used to standardize and restrict the information presented to a deep regression analysis pipeline, increasing information density and opening up a wide range of future medical inference studies.
blocks.zh: UK Biobank是英国的一项临床研究,除了收集到的大量医学数据外,还计划从10万名参与者中包括详细的磁共振成像(MRI)测试图. 图像数据可以通过自动配对分析与神经网络进行图像分解或分级分析等方法来分析,以扩大图像衍生的苯基的收集,用于医学研究. 在这项工作中,我们提出、提出和评价一种方法,利用基于图像的回归来估计从所收集的颈至膝水脂肪磁共振扫描中得出的数值属性。 它将一个ResNet50风格的网络应用于2D多通道拼接,它们代表来自核磁共振扫描的定向和特定解剖分区域。 通过将人工界定的次区域从参考扫描传播到使用图像登记的 > 30 000个分析扫描,实现了目标次区域取样。 由此产生的拼接可以紧凑而保留高分辨率,例如,为肾积回归网络提供多片肾组织. 这种方法还使得能够进行分组优势分析,突出显示网络用于预词的图像和解剖区域. 该方法被应用于肾体积,心体积和年龄等回归终点. 在R2 = 0.731-01-0.984之间发现了预测性能,并且发现以组别为主的显要地图突出出医学相关区域. 我们的结论是,这种方法可以用来使所提供的信息标准化,并限制在深度回归分析管道中,增加信息密度并开放广泛的未来医学推论研究。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
A popular method of medical imaging is Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) which uses magnetic fields and radio-waves to generate images with good soft tissue contrasts. Its non-invasive nature and the fact that it does not expose the scanned subjects to ionizing radiation makes it very useful both in clinical practice and research. Because of this, it is possible to conduct large-scale imaging studies on healthy individuals, such as UK Biobank [ 19 , 13 ] .
Further, MRI can produce 3D images with detailed anatomical information about organs, vessels and bone at high resolution. While large-scale collection of images is possible, however, large-scale analysis of said images is challenging. Manual analysis of MRI can require minutes or hours per image, making it slow or limited in scope to relatively small sample sizes.
blocks.zh:
一种流行的医学成像方法是磁共振成像法(MRI),它使用磁场和无线电波来生成具有良好软组织对比的图像. 它的非入侵性质以及它不使被扫描对象暴露于电离辐射的事实,使得它在临床实践和研究中都非常有用. 因此,有可能对健康个体进行大规模成像研究,例如英国生物银行[19,13].
此外,核磁共振还可以产生带有关于高分辨率器官、血管和骨骼的详细解剖信息的三维图像。 然而,虽然可以大规模收集图像,但大规模分析所述图像却具有挑战性。 对核磁共振的人工分析可以要求每个图像的分数或小时,使其在范围上缓慢或限于相对小的样本大小.

blocks.en: Machine learning techniques can provide major benefits by automating some of the required processing steps for image analysis. In the UK Biobank, proposed use cases for automation via neural networks include semantic segmentation for organ measurements [ 2 , 11 , 14 , 8 ] and quality control [ 3 ] , but also image-based, deep regression [ 10 ] . The latter can directly estimate numerical endpoints from image data, enabling a range of different predictions [ 21 , 5 ] . Whereas segmentation networks can perform pixel- or voxel-wise predictions, image-wise predictions by regression networks typically require larger quantities of training data [ 10 ] . This is especially the case for volumetric MR images with millions of voxel values, each of which could affect the prediction. Although image-based deep regression has been previously proposed for volumetric MRI [ 1 , 16 ] , images are often compressed or restrict to 2D.
blocks.zh: 机器学习技术可以通过自动化图像分析所需的一些处理步骤来提供重大的好处. 在"英国生物库"中,拟通过神经网络实现自动化的用例包括用于器官测量的语义分解[2,11,14,8]和质量控制[3],但也包括基于图像的深度回归[10]. 后者可以直接从图像数据中估算出数字端点,从而能够进行一系列不同的预测[21,5]. 虽然分块网络可以进行像素或阴道的预测,但回归网络的图像相感预测通常需要更多的培训数据[10]。 具有上百万伏克塞尔值的量子MR图像尤其如此,每种图像都可能影响预测。 虽然先前曾为量子核磁共振[1,16]提出过基于图像的深度回归,但图像往往被压缩或被限制为2D.

blocks.en: One major downside of neural networks is that it is often not clear what features are relevant for a given prediction [ 18 ] . This may be considered problematic since a network prediction does not inherently provide any insights into the logic behind this inference. This may reduce confidence in the prediction as well as making it more difficult to catch faulty predictions. This problem can be partially solved by the use of saliency maps. Saliency maps are a method of highlighting image regions with high impact on the network prediction, typically based on backpropagation of gradients in the network output back to the pixel inputs [ 18 ] . This can result in a map highlighting which input pixels had a large impact on the prediction. Individual saliency maps might however be noisy and difficult to interpret. If a large number of saliency maps are averaged, however, it is possible to pick out general patterns of general relevant features of the images [ 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 神经网络的一个主要缺点是,往往不清楚哪些特征与某一预测相关[18]. 这可能被认为是有问题的,因为网络预测从本质上讲不能说明这种推论背后的逻辑。 这可能降低对预测的信心,并更难得到错误的预测。 这个问题可以通过使用显要地图来部分地解决. 显著地图是一种突出图像区域的方法,对网络预测有较大影响,一般基于网络输出中梯度回向回向像素输入[18]. 这可以导致一张地图,突出显示哪些输入像素对预测有较大影响. 然而,个别的显著地图可能很吵,难以解释。 然而,如果平均绘制出大量显著地图,则可以选取图像一般相关特征的一般图案[12].

blocks.en: The main contribution of this work consists in combining image-based, deep regression and saliency analysis with a new type of input image format that represents volumetric MRI data in 2D collages showing anatomy that is targeted and specific to the given regression task. The method allows for manually defining specific regions of interest from a UK Biobank neck-to-knee MRI and automatically extracting the anatomically corresponding region in other images by leveraging image registration [ 6 ] . These regions are then used to generate a 2D multi-channel image and used as input for a ResNet50-style neural network. The approach was trained and evaluated on several endpoints for more than 30,000 UK Biobank neck-to-knee body MR images.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献是将基于图像的深度回归和显著性分析与新型输入图像格式相结合,在2D拼接中代表了量子磁共振数据,显示解剖学是针对特定回归任务的并具针对性的. 该方法可以手动定义英国Biobank颈至膝盖核磁共振中的特定区域,并借助图像注册[6],自动从其他图像中提取解剖对应区域. 这些区域随后被用来生成一个2D多通道的图像并用作ResNet50风格神经网络的输入. 该方法在3万多张英国 Biobank 从颈到膝的MR相片的几个端点上接受了培训和评估。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Overview of the targeted deep regression approach
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 目标深度回归方法概述

blocks.en: An overview of the targeted deep regression approach is given in Figure 1 . By use of image registrations manually selected target image slices and volumes is subsampled for all individuals and scans on a cohort study. The targeted image data is combined into a multi-channel 2D collage that is used as input to a regression network. Saliency analysis is used for interpretability. The image registrations furthermore enable group-wise or cohort saliency analysis.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了目标深度回归办法。 通过使用图像登记,对所有个人进行人工选择的目标图像切片和体积的分样,并在一组研究中进行扫描。 目标图像数据被组合成多通道的2D拼接,作为回归网络的输入. 重要性分析用于解释性。 图像登记还有助于对组别或组别进行显著性分析。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Illustration of the image analysis pipeline used for the targeted deep regression, with associated cohort saliency analysis that enables interpretability. Template scans (one male and one female) from the 3D water-fat MRI images in UK biobank are first selected. The targeted subsampling of the image data is manually defined using these. Image landmarks, subvolumes and projection are selected and used to target specific anatomical regions of the UK Biobank images and to convert the 3D image data into a 2D representation (e.g. axial mean intensity projection of a subvolume centered on the heart). Deformable image registration is used to transfer the manually selected landmarks and subvolumes into all individual scans. This allows targeted subsampling of the 3D data into a 2D representation from all scans. The extracted multi-channel 2D images are combined into a multi-channel collage for every scan. These collages are used as input to a regression network that is trained to predict a reference value of interest from each individual collage (e.g. the age of a subject). The trained regression networks are furthermore analyzed by performing saliency analysis for each performed inference. This gives an individual saliency result, i.e. a heatmap, for each collage, of what regions in a collage important for the performed task. By use of the image registration results these individual saliency results can be combined and aggregated into a cohort saliency map that shows a cohort-wise result of what regions that are important for the predictions (e.g. what regions are found most important for the age prediction task).
blocks.zh: 图1:说明用于目标深度回归的图像分析管道,并进行相关组群的突出性分析,以便能够解释。 英国生物库中从3D水肥核磁共振图像中首先选择了模板扫描(一男一女). 图像数据的目标分样是使用这些进行手动定义的。 图像地标,子卷和投影被选定并用于瞄准英国Biobank图像的特定解剖区域,并将3D图像数据转换为2D代表(例如以心脏为中心子卷的轴心平均强度投影). 可变形图像注册用于将手动选择的地标和子卷转移到所有单个扫描中. 这样可以将3D数据进行目标分样,从所有扫描中取出2D表示. 所提取出多道2D图像被组合成多道拼接器,用于每次扫描. 这些拼接被作为回归网络的输入,该网络经过培训,可以预测每个单项拼接的利息的参考值(例如一个被试对象的年龄). 对经过培训的回归网络进行进一步分析,对每一项进行的推断进行显著分析。 由此得出了个人的显著结果,即每次拼接对完成的任务很重要的拼接中哪些区域出现热图. 通过使用图像记录结果,这些单个的显著性结果可以合并成一个组群的显著性图,显示对预测很重要的区域(例如,哪些区域被认为对年龄预测任务最为重要)的分组结果。

blocks.en: 2.2 Data sets
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 数据集

blocks.en:
The MRI data and clinical data used in this study originates from UK Biobank, a large-scale study that collects health information on over half a million volunteers aged 44-82 years [ 19 ] . For 100,000 of these participants, further data collection is planned, including, but not limited to, whole-body MRI scans with neck-to-knee coverage. This study included over 40,000 of these whole-body MRI scans. The images were collected using a dual-echo Dixon protocol with a 1.5 T MR Siemens Aera device. These scans allow analysis of images of water signal, fat signal as well as quantitative water fraction as well as fat fraction images [ 22 ] , with TR = 6.69 ​ ms \text{TR}=6.69\text{ms} , TE = 2.39 ​ / ​ 4.77 ​ ms \text{TE}=2.39\text{/}4.77\text{ms} and flip angle = 10 \text{flip angle}=10 °.
The dimensions of each voxel are 2.23mm × \times 2.23 mm with the last dimension varying, being 3 mm, 3.5 mm, or 4.5 mm [ 13 ] . For the purposes of having consistent sizes, all images were resampled to an effective voxel resolution of 2.23mm × \times 2.23mm × \times 3mm (SAG × \times COR × \times AX).
blocks.zh:
本研究中使用的核磁共振数据和临床数据出自英国生物银行,这是一项大规模研究,收集了50多万名44-82岁志愿者的健康信息[19]. 对于其中的100,000名参与者,计划进一步收集数据,包括但不限于全身核磁共振扫描,并覆盖颈至膝盖。 这项研究包括40 000多件这种全身核磁共振扫描。 图像的采集使用双echo Dixon协议并配有1.5T MR Siemens Aera设备. 这些扫描可以分析水信号,脂肪信号以及定量水分和脂肪分相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
每瓶活塞的尺寸为2.23mm×\times 2.23mm,后一尺寸各有不同,为3mm,3.5mm,或4.5mm[13]. 为了有一致的大小,所有图像被重印到2.23mm ×\times 2.23mm ×\times 3mm(SAG ×\times COR ×\times AX)的有效阴道分辨率.

blocks.en: The numerical values that served as ground truth for the regression targets of age, kidney volume, and heart volume were gathered from several different sources. For age, the UK Biobank metadata provided only the year and month of birth (UK Biobank fields 34 and 52). Every subject was therefore assumed to be born in the middle of the month, so that any error in the ground truth data amounts to at most half a month [ 12 ] . The values for kidney volume were based on prior work that utilized convolutional neural network for segmentation of the same neck-to-knee body MRI as used here [ 11 ] . The measurements of the heart consist of the left ventricular end-diastolic volume (LV-EDV) (UK Biobank field 22421) [ 20 ] . It is worth noting that the ground truth dataset for LV-EDV is noisy and UK Biobank includes a warning of non-quality controlled data for this parameter, with the original set of reference measurements containing values from a few 10s of mL to 15,000 mL (see UK Biobank field 22421). To limit the impact of these errors, the data was therefore filtered to exclude any participant with a value higher than 260 ml.
blocks.zh: 数字值是年龄、肾脏体积和心脏体积等回归目标的基本真理,从几个不同来源收集。 就年龄而言,联合王国生物库元数据只提供了出生年份和月份(联合王国生物库领域34和52)。 因此,每个主体都被假定为生于正月中,因此,地面真实数据中的任何错误最多相当于半月[12]. 肾脏体积的数值是根据以前的工作计算的,以前的工作利用了演化神经网络来分解同一种颈至膝的体磁共振[11]。 心脏的测量由左心口末端分泌体积(LV-EDV)(UK Biobank field 22421) [20]. 值得注意的是,LV-EDV的地面真伪数据集很吵,而UK Biobank包括了对该参数的不质量受控数据的警告,原始的参考测量数据包含从几所10s的mL到15,000mL的数值(见UK Biobank field 22421). 因此,为了限制这些错误的影响,对数据进行了过滤,以排除任何价值高于260毫升的参与者。

blocks.en: The UK Biobank study and the experiments performed here were approved by the British and Swedish ethics committees, respectively. The subject gave written informed consent, and the study has been performed according to the Declaration of Helsinki [ 19 ] . The UK Biobank data was accessed via the UK Biobank website 1 1 1 https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/ and their associated Access Management System 2 2 2 https://ams.ukbiobank.ac.uk/ams/ . Data is de-identified/pseudo-anonymized by the UK Biobank organization before it is shared.
blocks.zh: 英国生物银行的研究和在这里进行的实验分别得到英国和瑞典伦理委员会的批准. 该主题提供了书面知情同意,研究是根据赫尔辛基宣言[19]进行的。 英国生物银行数据通过英国生物银行网站1 1 1 https://www.ukbiobank.ac.uk/及其相关的访问管理系统2 2 https://ams.ukbiobank.ac.uk/ams/。 数据在共享之前由英国生物银行组织去识别/假匿名.

blocks.en: 2.3 Targeted image collages
blocks.zh: 2.3 目标图像拼接

blocks.en:
The input images provided to the neural network were formatted as targeted collages, i.e. the format was designed specifically for a given regression task, based on a research hypothesis. This was done by manually targeting specific regions of interest to be sampled, such that any anatomical area important for the measurement was in the targeted volumes, see Figure 1 . A rectangular region of interest was defined and specified by its midpoint and side lengths in the male and female reference subjects respectively. Similar samples were then taken from the remaining images by using deformation fields to map the midpoint of the region of interest to its respective location in the non-reference images. For each image, a region of interest of the same size was then sampled around this new midpoint.
Because the network requires the input to be a 2D image, sampled 3D regions were then projected by calculating the mean intensity value along a specified direction.
blocks.zh:
提供给神经网络的输入图像被格式化为定向拼接,即该格式是根据研究假说专门为特定回归任务而设计的. 这样做的方法是手动将特定感兴趣的区域作为取样对象,因此,对测量工作很重要的任何解剖区都属于目标数量,见图一。 男女参考科目的中点和边长分别界定和具体规定了具有长方形意义的区域。 然后,利用变形场从所剩图像中取出类似样本,将感兴趣的区域的中点绘制到不参考图像中各自的位置。 对每个图像,在新的中点周围抽取一个面积相同的区域。
由于网络需要输入为一二维图像,因此被抽样的3D区域随后通过按照指定方向计算平均强度值来预测.

blocks.en: 2.4 Image registration
blocks.zh: 2.4 国家 图像注册

blocks.en:
Image registration was used to map manually defined regions of interest from a reference image to corresponding regions in all other images.
The image registrations were created by selecting a reference image/subject from each sex and registering all other images to the reference image of the corresponding sex.
The reference images were chosen to have an average tissue composition and were quality controlled for artifacts.
The image registration used a deformable image registration method based on graph-cuts utilizing the software deform [ 6 ] that generated, for each image, deformation field mappings (vector fields) between a sex-specific reference and a given target image.
Each deformation field describes how points in the reference images map to the target image and can be used to map manually defined coordinates in the reference persons to corresponding points in all other images.
blocks.zh:
图像登记被用来将所有其它图像中从参考图像到相应区域的人工定义感兴趣区域映射。
图像注册是通过从每个性别中选择一个参考图像/主体和将所有其他图像登记到相应性别的参考图像来创建的.
参考图像被选为平均组织组成,并对文物进行质量控制.
图像注册采用可变形图像注册方法,以图表剪接为基础,利用软件变形[6],为每个图像生成针对性别的参考物和特定目标图像之间的变形场映射(矢量场)。
每个变形字段描述参考图像图中与目标图像的分点,并可用于将参考人物中手动定义的坐标映射到所有其他图像中的相应分点.

blocks.en: 2.5 Multi-channel collage construction
blocks.zh: 2.5 多渠道拼接建筑

blocks.en:
After sampling all desired regions and projecting them onto 2D, the resulting 2D images of targeted anatomical areas were arranged into one collage for each MR image, as shown in Figure 2. These collages were fed to the neural network.
Minimizing the size of the collage is important for performance reasons and is a packing problem. This minimization was done using the rectangle-packer package for Python 3 3 3 https://pypi.org/project/rectangle-packer/ . When a satisfactory packing was been achieved the water signal, fat signal as well as either water fraction or fat fraction images are combined into a 3 channel 256 × \times 256 image.
For storage reasons the images were saved in 8-bit unsigned integer format. This was not found to have any noticeable negative impact on the predictive performance of the network. Because the intensity values range from 0 0 to about 1500 1500 , the intensity values were scaled down such as to fit in the 0 0 - 255 255 range of the uint8 format. For the fat and water image this was done by normalizing the image intensities after clipping the top 1% of the brightest voxel values and any negative values potentially resulting from the spline interpolation.
blocks.zh:
如图2所示,在对所有理想区域进行取样并投射到2D后,将目标解剖区的2D图像排列成每个MR图像的一个拼接. 这些拼接被喂入神经网络.
尽量减少拼接的大小对性能很重要,是一个包装问题。 将Python 3 3 3 https://pypi.org/project/rectangle-packer/使用矩形-包装软件包进行最小化。 水信号完成后,脂肪信号以及水分或脂肪分等图像被组合成3道256×分秒256图像。
出于存储原因,图像以8位无符号的整数格式被保存. 这被认为对网络的预测性能没有任何明显的负面影响。 由于强度值从0 0到约1500 1500,因此强度值被缩小,以适应于0 - 255 255 范围的uint8格式. 对于脂肪和水的图像,这是在剪接了最亮的花瓶值的上1%和可能由丝状插值产生的任何负值之后,使图像强度正常化。

blocks.en: 2.6 Network
blocks.zh: 2.6 网络

blocks.en: A ResNet50 [ 7 ] architecture was used to perform the regression with pre-training being done on ImageNet [ 10 ] . The network was trained using the Adam optimizer [ 9 ] for 10,000 iterations with the learning rate decreasing by a factor 10 after 8,000 iterations. The training code is publicly available 4 4 4 github.com/tarolangner/ukb_mimir . We used a batch size of 20 due to the limited memory of the NVidia 1060 GPU which has 6GB of memory. The time to train the network for 10,000 iterations was approximately 1.5 hours.
blocks.zh: ResNet50[7]架构用于实现回归,在ImageNet上进行预训[10]. 网络的培训使用亚当优化器[9],用于一万个迭代,学习率在8000个迭代后下降了10倍. 训练守则公开 4 4 4 github.com/tarolangner/ukb_mimir. 由于NVidia 1060 GPU的内存有限,我们使用了20个批量尺寸,它有6GB的内存. 为10 000次重复培训网络的时间约为1.5小时。

blocks.en: 2.7 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.7 评价

blocks.en: The evaluation was performed using 10-fold cross validation [ 17 ] , for a setup of training on 90% of the data and validating on the remaining 10% in a rotating scheme. To evaluate the predictive performance of the network we used the mean absolute error (MAE) and mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) to measure the average accuracy of the predictions. The latter was defined as the mean over all absolute differences between prediction and ground truth, each divided by the corresponding ground truth. Pearson’s coefficient of correlation (r), the coefficient of determination ( R 2 R^{2} ), and the 95% limits of agreement (LoA) were used to compare the model predictions and the known ground truth values. Bland-Altman plots were also generated to evaluate the results.
blocks.zh: 评估是通过10倍交叉验证[17]进行的,目的是对90%的数据进行培训,并在轮换计划中验证其余10%的数据。 为了评价网络的预测性能,我们使用平均绝对错误(MAE)和平均绝对百分比错误(MAPE)来测量预测的平均准确性. 后者被定义为对预测和地面真理之间所有绝对差异的取舍,两者均被相应的地面真理所除. Pearson的关联系数(r),确定系数(R 2 R^{2}),以及协议的95%的限度(LoA)被用来比较模型预测和已知的地真值. 还制作了布兰德-阿尔特曼地块以评估结果。

blocks.en: 2.8 Group-wise saliency analysis
blocks.zh: 2.8 集团优势分析

blocks.en: The saliency analysis was performed for each individual regression task by simple backpropagation using built-in methods in PyTorch. The individual saliency maps were combined from all inferences in the cross-validation into group-wise average saliencies for males and females, respectively. For each image in each individual collage, the saliency map was deformed back using the performed image registration to standardize the geometry. This was done by first mapping each image back to the reference by inverting the deformation fields using simpleitk [ 15 , 23 , 4 ] . This inversion was performed on each sample after projection, thus requiring the inversion of only a 2D field, greatly reducing the computational cost. This also allows us to create a deformation field collage mapped the same as the image collage.
blocks.zh: 通过使用PyTorch的内置方法进行简单的回放,对每个单向回归任务进行了显著性分析。 从交叉验证中的所有推论中,将个人的显著性图分别合并为男女组别的平均健康图。 对于每个单相拼图中的每个图像,使用已实现的图像登记来将几何标准化,其显著地图被变形回. 这是通过首先将每个图像映射回参照物,通过使用简 [15, 23, 4]倒置变形场来完成的. 这种倒置是在投影后在每个样本上进行的,因此只需要倒置一个2D字段,大大降低了计算成本. 这也使我们能够创建一个与图像拼接图相同的变形场拼接图.

blocks.zh: 2.9 实验

blocks.en: 3 Results

blocks.en: Evaluation metrics for all regression targets are summarized in Table 1 . Input collages were furthermore visualized for each of the four experiments, overlaid with the corresponding aggregated saliency maps, together with scatter plots and Bland-Altman plots in the Figures 5 , 6 , 7 , and 8 , respectively.

blocks.en: For the kidney volume experiment the results were highly accurate, with a mean absolute error of 6.8 mL and a mean absolute percentage error of about 2.8%. Further, the saliency maps showed that the network was able to locate and use the image information in kidneys with rather high accuracy.
blocks.zh: 对于肾脏体积实验,结果非常准确,平均绝对误差为6.8 mL,平均绝对误差约为2.8%. 此外,显著的地图显示,该网络能够以相当高的准确度定位和使用肾脏中的图像信息。

blocks.en: The prediction of LV-EDV was not as accurate as for kidney volume, with a mean absolute error of 12.3 mL and a mean absolute percentage error of 9.8%. The saliency maps show that the method is able to localize and use information from region of the left ventricle.

blocks.en: Regarding the age predictions they resulted in similar performance using sagittal and axial slicing, with the latter performing slightly numerically superior. The group-wise saliency maps were also seen to highlight similar regions using both slice orientations. The regions were identified as left atrium, spinal vertebras and a region in the lungs was found highlighted in both males and females using both slice orientations.

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: We have in this work presented and evaluated a methodology for targeted deep regression using tailored collages that can represent specific morphological information of MR image data and highlight anatomical structures relevant for the prediction with saliency analysis. The proposed technique formats the MRI data into one 2D collage for each subject, based on manually selected regions of interest that are defined in one male and one female template subject and then propagated to all other neck-to-knee body MRI scans with the help of image registration. Predictive performance was found between R 2 = 0.731 ​ — ​ 0.984 R^{2}=0.731\text{---}0.984 and the group-wise saliency maps were found to highlight medically relevant regions.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出并评估了一种有针对性地进行深度回归的方法,使用量身定制的拼接,可以代表MR图像数据的具体形态信息,并用显著性分析突出与预测有关的解剖结构。 拟议的技术将磁共振数据格式化为每个题材的一个2D拼接器,其基础是人工选定的感兴趣的区域,这些区域在一个雄性和一个雌性模板题材中定义,然后在图像登记的帮助下传播到所有其他颈至膝体磁共振扫描器。 预测性能在R 2 = 0.731 - 0.984 R^{2}=0.731\text{-}0.984之间发现. 发现小组的显著位置图突出了与医学有关的区域。

blocks.en: The kidney volume regression achieved high accuracy and distinctly highlighted salient kidney tissue in the axial mean intensity projection of the collages, as seen in Fig. 5(a) and Fig. 5(b) . The mean absolute percentage error of 2.8% achieved here rivals the intra-operator variability achieved by human annotators cited in the original work that provided the underlying kidney volume measurements based on neural networks for semantic segmentation [ 11 ] . It also clearly outperformed a previously proposed approach that reported a relative error of 7% for the same kidney volume measurements, based on a more generic deep regression approach on mean intensity projections of the UK Biobank neck-to-knee body MRI [ 10 ] . It is possible that the projection images are on average more useful for a network to focus on as it shows less variation in the presentation compared to a sampled slice determined using image registration as a projection image contains both depth and width information in intensity and in-slice span.
blocks.zh: 如图5(a)和图5(b)所示,肾体积回归的精度较高,在轴心平均强度预测中明显突出肾组织。 此处实现2.8%的平均绝对误差与原始作品中引用的人类注解者实现的操作内可变性相抗衡,该图提供了基于神经网络的肾积分测量结果[11]. 它还明显地超过了先前提出的一种方法,即根据联合王国Biobank颈至膝盖体核磁共振平均强度预测的更通用的深度回归方法,报告同一肾体积测量的相对误差为7%[10]。 投影图像对于一个网络来说,平均来说可能更有用,因为它显示,与采用图像登记作为投影图像的样本确定的片段相比,投影图像在显示强度和切片间距上都包含深度和宽度信息,因此显示显示的显示差异较小。

blocks.en: The prediction accuracy of LV-EDV was somewhat lower than when predicting kidney volume. This was expected since LV-EDV is more challenging due to the nature of the left ventricle volume being a subregion of the heart as well as not being constant over the heart beat. This means the network must not only be able to recognize the heart but also its smaller sub-volumes. Further, the UK Biobank reference values were originally acquired using dedicated cardiac MRI scans collected using ECG-triggered scanning [ 20 ] . This means that the images used here for predictions are less suitable than the ones used for collecting the ground truth, leading to worse results. As we seen in the saliency maps of Fig. 6(a) and 6(b) , however, the network was on average capable of locating the heart as well as recognizing the left ventricle (located in the lower right part of the heart in the images) in the collages.
blocks.zh: LV-EDV的预测精度略低于预测肾量时. 由于左外出口量的性质是心脏的一个次区域,而且心脏跳动时没有恒定,因此LV-EDV是更具挑战性的。 这意味着网络不仅必须能够识别心脏,还必须识别其较小的分卷. 此外,联合王国生物库的参考值最初是使用使用ECG-触发扫描收集的专用心脏核磁共振扫描[20]获得的。 这意味着这里用于预测的图像不如用于收集地上真相的图像合适,导致更糟糕的结果. 然而,我们从图6(a)和图6(b)的显著地图中看到,该网络平均能够确定心脏的位置,并识别接合物中的左口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口

blocks.en: The age regression experiments yielded predictions with a mean absolute error just below 3 years, using image data from the mediastinal region only. In related work, a volumetric age regression approach on UK Biobank neck-to-knee body MRI yielded a mean absolute error of 3.6 years [ 16 ] , whereas earlier work on 2D mean intensity projections achieved about 2.5 years [ 12 ] . The latter found aggregated saliency analysis highlighting predominantly structures of the aortic arch and knees relevant for age.
blocks.zh: 年龄回归实验得出了平均绝对误差略低于3年的预测,只使用介质区域的图像数据. 在相关工作中,英国Biobank颈部至膝盖体核磁共振的体积年龄回归法得出了3.6年[16]的平均绝对误差,而早先的2D平均强度预测工作则达到了2.5年[12]左右. 后者发现综合优势分析主要突出主动脉拱门和膝盖的结构与年龄有关。

blocks.en: In the experiments performed in the current study we note high saliency in the heart (left atrium) in spine and lung tissue, with little emphasis on the aortic arch. These patterns were seen in both females and males and in the experiment using axial and sagittal projections (see Fig. 7(a) and Fig. 7(b) ).
blocks.zh: 在本次研究中进行的实验中,我们注意到脊椎和肺组织中的心脏(左原子)高度突出,很少强调主动脉拱. 这些模式在女性和男性中都有,在实验中使用轴向和地平线预测(见图7(a)和图7(b))。

blocks.en: The targeted sampling can maximize the amount of relevant information in the created collage by targeting specific regions, here kidney and heart for the volume estimation experiments. It can also tailor an experiment for machine-learning based studies of associations between certain organs or tissues and specific biomarkers of interest, such as the thoracic region and age examined here. For both the kidney and heart (LV-EDV) volume experiments the relevant information was readily available in the source image data, limited only by the image quality, e.g. the non-ECG-triggered scans of the whole-body volume. The created collages also aimed to maximize the information in the input format for the neural network, though with the risk that the projections used would result in too much information being lost. Furthermore, these experiments were also made with strong prior knowledge on where the network could be expected to focus its attention to optimize the predictions.
blocks.zh: 目标取样可针对特定区域,即肾脏和心脏进行体积估计实验,使所创建的拼接中相关信息的数量最大化。 它还可以为某些器官或组织与感兴趣的特定生物标志(例如这里检查的胸腺区域和年龄)之间的关联进行基于机器学习的研究而专门设计一个实验. 对于肾脏和心脏(LV-EDV)体积实验,在源成像数据中都很容易获得相关信息,仅限于图像质量,例如全身体积的非ECG-触发扫描. 所创建的拼贴图还旨在将神经网络输入格式中的信息最大化,尽管其所使用的预测可能导致过多的信息丢失. 此外,在进行这些实验时,事先还十分了解网络应注重哪些方面优化预测。

blocks.en: We note that the in the volume predictions illustrated in Figures 4 and 5 the groups-wise saliency tends to prefer projections over slices. We hypothesize that this might be due to the fact that the projections contain information from larger volumes compared to slices and thus contain more useful information for volume predictions. It might also be that individual slices show more variability in content and appearance that makes it more difficult for a network to use in the predictions. This illustrates the potential of using different targeting or subsampling strategies to compare the "importance" of different regions and sampling strategies for the predictions.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,图4和图5所示的数量预测中,分组优势往往倾向于预测而不是切片。 我们假设,这可能是因为预测中包含来自比片量更大的信息,因此包含对量预测更有用的信息。 也可能是单个片段在内容和外观上表现出更多的可变性,使得一个网络在预测中更难被使用. 这说明使用不同的目标选择或分样战略来比较不同区域的"重要性"和预测的抽样战略的潜力.

blocks.en: One limitation of the image formatting used here consists in the need for two reference images, one for each sex. Due to this, two targeted samplings are necessary which cannot be strictly guaranteed to be identical. This might limit studies on, for example, sex-related differences. The sex-specific sampling may lead to the sex being obvious even without learning any anatomical differences between the sexes. If, as an extreme case, the heart of all male subjects was sampled but the corresponding region of interest for female subjects was placed with a significant offset, the network may easily predict sex without actually learning anything of use for the intended study. Future work could focus on mitigating this problem, for example by registering one of the references to the other. Then only one image would need to be sampled since the sampling could be automatically transferred to the other reference, similarly to how it is done with the rest of the data set.
blocks.zh: 这里使用的图像格式的一个限制是需要两个参考图像,每个性别一个. 因此,必须进行两次目标明确的取样,但不能严格保证其相同。 这可能会限制对诸如与性别有关的差异的研究。 按性别分类的抽样可能导致性别明显,即使没有了解性别之间的解剖差异。 如果作为极端案例,对所有男性科目的核心进行了抽样,但将女性科目感兴趣的相应区域置于了显著的抵消位置,那么网络可能很容易预测性别,而实际上却不学习任何对预定研究有用的东西。 今后的工作可以侧重于减轻这一问题,例如,将其中之一提到另一个。 然后只需对一幅图像进行取样,因为采样可以自动转移到另一幅参考,类似于如何用其他数据集进行。

blocks.en: In conclusion we have presented and evaluated a methodology for tailored deep regression that can be used to specify and restrict the image data presented to a 2D deep regression analysis pipeline, allowing higher information density and a wide range of future medical inference studies. Beyond just estimating missing measurements, the presented saliency mapping technique provides a visualization of the "black box" analysis performed. The resulting saliency maps enable a biological interpretation and hypothesis generation, opening up a wide range of potential future regression experiments that can integrate imaging and non-imaging information.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们提出并评估了一种针对特定深度回归的方法,可以用来具体说明和限制所呈现的图像数据,将其限制在二维深度回归分析管道中,从而能够提高信息密度并进行广泛的未来医学推论研究。 除了仅仅估计缺失的测量值外,所呈现的突出的绘图技术还提供了所完成的"黑盒"分析的可视化. 由此而来的重要地图使得生物解释和假说生成成为可能,开启了广泛的未来可能的回归实验,可以将成像和非成像信息相融合.
